title: Batch counter packaging
goal: A packer can see the product count, full-package divert action, and guarded counter reset.

rubric.must: A CTU block labelled PackageCounter visibly shows a preset of 12 and is preceded by ProductPhotoeye.
A PackageCounter.Q contact visibly energises the DivertGate coil.
PackageCounter.Q visibly drives the BatchFullLamp coil on a separate rung.
A normally closed PackageCounter.Q contact visibly drives PackageRun.
ResetPB and PackageClear contacts visibly precede the PackageCounter reset coil.
An ONS symbol labelled ProductPhotoeye is visibly placed on the counting rung.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 visibly satisfies all six rules, while image 2 uses different labels and omits the required PackageRun rung.
